source_text:
9.14 ̔Ο ὑψῶν με ἐκ τῶν πυλῶν τοῦ
θανάτου. Ινα μὴ καὶ πύλαι τοῦ ᾳ δου κατισχύσωσιν αὐτοῦ, αι τινές εἰσιν αἱ κακίαι
κατάγουσαι εἰς πυθμένα ᾳ δου.
pass_a_gloss: The one-lifting me out-of the gates of-the death. In-order-that not also gates of-the Hades might-prevail-against him, which-very-ones are the vices leading-down into bottom of-Hades.
pass_b_english: “The one who lifts me from the gates of death” (Psalm 9:14).
So that the gates of Hades might not prevail against him either, which are the vices that lead down to the bottom of Hades (Matthew 16:18).

choices.why: Identified as vices leading down to the bottom of Hades, echoing Matthew 16:18. Not city-gates of a graveyard.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
